questions.question: What famous poem opens Ecclesiastes 3?
options: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth
For everything there is a season, and a time for every matter
Better is the end of a thing than its beginning
Cast your bread upon the waters, and find it after many days
questions.answer: For everything there is a season, and a time for every matter

questions.question: What has God made everything, according to Ecclesiastes 3?
options: Beautiful in its time, and put eternity into man's heart
Subject to chance, beyond all human understanding
Plain and lowly, so that man would not boast
Fleeting like a shadow, with no purpose under heaven
questions.answer: Beautiful in its time, and put eternity into man's heart

questions.question: Ecclesiastes 3 says there is a time to be born and a time to die, a time to weep and a time to laugh.
For everything there is a season, and a time for every _____ under heaven.
He has made everything beautiful in its _____.
